name: What factors influence the cost of kitchen cabinet installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of kitchen cabinet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Overall costs depend primarily on kitchen size, cabinet construction grade, and any framing repairs needed before hanging. Prefabricated stock cabinets cost the least, while semi-custom and custom cabinets require more investment due to thicker plywood boxes, custom dimensions, and detailed finish trim. Labor pricing reflects site conditions: older homes with sagging floors or bowed drywall require additional carpentry hours for shimming and scribing. Upgrades like decorative end panels, soft-close hardware, integrated pull-outs, and multi-piece crown moldings also affect final installation pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet materials, kitchen size, site prep for uneven framing, and decorative trim details like crown molding determine the total installation cost.
